summary: Luciole Mono is a terminal font intended to improve legibility in command‑line interfaces. It is distributed as a simple CLI/GUI/IDE utility without a PyPI package and runs locally. It suits users who need a monospaced font with better math glyphs, but its lack of community adoption and negligible performance gains limit its appeal. The main strength is its focus on legibility, while the primary drawback is its minimal differentiation from established fonts and poor test coverage.

github.description: Monospaced version of the Luciole typeface (for visually impaired readers), for terminals and code editors — CC-BY 4.0
